texts.memorize: Remember where the pieces are: the position is about to disappear.
texts.visualize: The position is hidden: picture it with your eyes closed.
texts.listen: Play them in your head on the hidden position.
texts.askPiece: Pick the piece from the tray.
texts.askMany: Click every square that answers, then “Submit”.
texts.right: You see the position without seeing it.
texts.wrong: Look at the position: the right answer is in green.
texts.followUp: Same route: keep it in mind.

verdicts.knight_jumps: It took {n} jump. | It took {n} jumps.
